chapter: Publishing, Jelly Roll in Los Angeles and band lore
title: Floyd Ray's band and Johnny's unperformed operetta
summary: Spikes knows little of Floyd Ray's band, and says Johnny wrote an operetta, As You Sow, So Shall You Reap, that was never performed.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How about Floyd Ray? He had a band here, didn't he?
Floyd Ray? Yeah, he had a band.
And who played in that band? Do you remember?
And, oh, you mentioned that your brother Johnny was writing an opera. Did he ever finish that?
Uh...let's see, Johnny [unintelligible]... I think he did. I think it's all up there in the...up there in that place up there. I think when he died, I think his wife brought all that...she's
got a lot of stuff stored up there that belonged to Johnny--just left it up there. He was writing a operetta--"As You Sow, So Shall You Reap."
